literal_beta_bridge.canonical_residual_gate: given dyadic endpoint control, the exact residual is the maximal beta bridge B_0=X^o(1); no universal minimality claim is made
literal_beta_bridge.rh_equivalence: RH iff both the dyadic endpoint gate and beta bridge gate are X^o(1)

source_blind_sampling.adaptive_verdict: the same lower bound holds for deterministic adaptive value queries by answering zero and hiding an excursion in the final largest gap; randomized guarantees are not analyzed
source_blind_sampling.dyadic_or_logarithmic_verdict: cannot control arbitrary admissible coefficients source-blindly
source_blind_sampling.sharp_lower_bound: for m sampled endpoints, some admissible sequence has every sample zero and max prefix >=sqrt(X)/(2*(m+1))-1/(2*sqrt(X))
source_blind_sampling.subpower_frontier: worst-case subpower error requires m>=X^(1/2-o(1)); m=X^(1/2+o(1)) suffices
source_blind_sampling.sufficient_mesh: if max_j(sqrt(e_(j+1))-sqrt(e_j))<=R, then max_Y|F_Y(t)|<=max_(e in E)|F_e(t)|+2*C*R

source_contract.imports: one-harmonic maximal-prefix RH equivalence and exact common guarded frequency

square_root_endpoint_theorem.theorem: for any fixed nonzero harmonic, a predetermined square-root mesh with R=X^o(1) gives an endpoint-only RH-equivalent target
